n6: Be clear about what a gateway is today. A key, when an endpoint needs one, goes to your keychain, never the config, and only over HTTPS or loopback. Turns stream, but they don't get Keelson's tools, and they don't resume a session, so each turn starts fresh. A model with no price reads unpriced, so it never looks free by accident.
n7: So you can try the whole harness with nothing to buy, keep a conversation on your own machine, or point it at the endpoint your team already runs.
